name: toolathlon-fixtures
comment: The whole npm surface the two TypeScript fakes need, spelled out here
rather than installed from mirage's own workspace. Between the kit,
gws, notion and hf-hub the only non-node imports are
@modelcontextprotocol/sdk and js-yaml -- so the alternative was a
prisma is a runtime dependency, not a dev one: the kit shells out to
`prisma db push` to build the template database each run file is
js-yaml is hf-hub's: /api/validate-yaml refuses a card whose captured
frontmatter does not parse, which needs a real parser. Held at the
version mirage's own integ/package.json resolves, because a fake that
parses differently than the one upstream tests answers differently.
graphql is github's: from mirage bb07269a2 it answers POST /graphql
for issue comments with graphql's own executor, held at the version
mirage's integ/package.json pins, for the same reason.
